actuatorlist: compare robot actuators by torque, weight and price

actuatorlist is an independent, open catalog of the actuators that move robots: quasi-direct-drive motors, integrated joints, smart servos, harmonic and cycloidal reducers, and frameless motor kits. It holds 80 actuators from 31 brands in 6 categories, plus 22 robots with the motor in each joint. Robot builders use it to shortlist actuators for quadruped legs, humanoid joints and robot arms by the numbers that decide a build: peak torque, weight, torque density and price.

Browse the catalog

  • Leaderboard: torque density rankings and a torque versus cost scatter.
  • Actuators: every entry as a photo gallery or one sortable table.
  • Robots: which motors sit in each joint of real robots.
  • For AI agents: REST API, MCP server and markdown views.

Actuator categories

  • QDD / Proprioceptive (10): Quasi-direct-drive motors with low gear ratios; backdrivable, used in legged robots.
  • Integrated Joint (19): Motor, gearbox, encoder and driver in one housing, sized for arm and humanoid joints.
  • Smart Servo (18): Compact bus servos with onboard control, common in hobby and research arms.
  • Harmonic / Precision (11): Strain-wave (harmonic) gearing with near-zero backlash for precise positioning.
  • Frameless + Driver (14): Frameless motor kits and standalone motor drivers for custom actuator builds.
  • Cycloidal / Premium (8): Cycloidal and RV reducers for high-torque, shock-tolerant industrial joints.
